name: deriv-api
description: Get live Deriv API schemas plus guides for authentication, subscriptions, trades, and errors.

interface.longDescription: Get live Deriv API schemas plus guides for authentication, subscriptions, trades, and errors. Search endpoints, read current request and response fields, take worked examples, and validate payloads. The plugin does not sign in to a Deriv account, store keys, or place trades.
defaultPrompt: Look up the live request and response schema for a Deriv API endpoint
Validate this Deriv API request payload against the live schema
Explain Deriv API authentication, subscriptions, and error handling
